_comment: appbox companion runtime config — bundled with the app (R3: no literals in code). Mirrors the desktop app's config pattern. Heartbeat cadence, reconnect/dead thresholds and the Bonjour service type live here; code reads them, never inlines them.

channel._comment: The paired channel's liveness signal. The companion heartbeats the prototype URL over HTTP — this is the channel state the FAB carries (live/reconnecting/dead), never whether the WebView painted. deadAfterFailures consecutive failures within heartbeat cadence flip the FAB to dead within one heartbeat window.

discovery._comment: LAN-local pairing (12.5 — no cloud relay). The Bonjour service type the desktop advertises and the companion browses for. Must match the iOS Info.plist NSBonjourServices entry (an OS requirement — the plist is the only place iOS reads it).

pairing._comment: QR-relay defense (12.4). The nonce is single-use; the QR rotates on this cadence; a paired session idles out and is dropped after this many seconds of inactivity.

readyLine._comment: The P09 spawn contract — one JSON object the desktop emits once the prototype server is listening. The companion matches this tag to find the URL/port/host in the channel payload, never a literal URL.

fab._comment: FAB constraints (12.10). It occludes by definition — the edge-dock inset parks it off the prototype content, and the home-indicator keepout stops it parking over the gesture area. Values are logical pixels from the screen edge.
